blocking: Floating controls can remain keyboard-focusable while visually hidden.
The accordion's height reservation excludes expanded Read more content, so switching panels can move the page below it.

fixes.what: Remove hidden controls from the tab order immediately, or add focus handlers that synchronously reveal them. Eliminate the 700ms mismatch between visibility and keyboard availability.
fixes.why: Keyboard users can currently land on an invisible control during the hiding interval.

fixes.where: assets/js/site.js — accordion reserveHeight() and Read more
fixes.what: Recalculate the reserved height when details toggle, measuring all panels at the actual expanded width and preserving their open states.
fixes.why: The initial measurement covers closed details only; opening a long description and switching panels changes the row height.

fixes.where: assets/js/site.js — same-page anchors and history handling
fixes.what: Handle popstate/hashchange by opening the corresponding celebration panel and restoring target focus and header clearance without adding another history entry.
fixes.why: Back navigation can restore a celebration hash while its panel remains collapsed.

fixes.what: Use a metrics-adjusted fallback with font-display:swap, and verify layout stability under a throttled font request.
fixes.why: font-display:block can hide nearly all text while loading and does not guarantee freedom from layout shifts.
